person.name: Nguyen Quoc Vuong
person.headline: Senior Front-end Engineer
person.intro: Nearly 9 years building web products, with a focus on front-end architecture and web performance. In 2026 I started learning 3D web and building my own products with AI agents.

stations.title: Opus Solution
stations.summary: Enterprise digital transformation products on Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.
highlights: Tasken: task and performance management SPA with a hierarchical organization tree
Document management dashboards for enterprise clients
Responsive report tables with PDF and Excel export for oil and gas production data

stations.title: QueenB JSC
stations.summary: Webinar marketing platforms and website builders.
highlights: Webinaris: cross-platform HLS and MPEG-DASH playback for the German market
Bonevo: drag-and-drop page settings and image editing
Tuoi Tre Tim Viec: high-traffic job board pages and posting workflow

stations.title: Firegroup
stations.summary: Front-end architecture for global e-commerce SaaS apps on Shopify.
highlights: Swift App: merchant sites above 80 PageSpeed points, passing LCP, INP and CLS
OneMobile: micro front-end admin so 2 Scrum teams ship independently
OneLoyalty: Shadow DOM isolation cut theme style conflicts by over 90%

stations.title: Save Game Sync
stations.role: Solo: idea, architecture, CI/CD and releases
stations.summary: Windows tray app that syncs game saves to Google Drive across handhelds and laptops.
highlights: Watches game processes, tracks play time and syncs saves on exit
Three-way reconciliation with SHA-256 identity and crash-safe local journal
Self-updating releases from GitHub Actions

split.me: Product idea, architecture, agent instructions, reviewing and merging every change
split.ai: Most of the Rust code, generated with GitHub Copilot, Codex and Claude Code
split.evidence: 274 commits, 31 merged pull requests, tagged releases

stations.title: Road to English C1
stations.summary: Offline-first PWA for learning English from B1 to C1 with real work scenarios.
highlights: 91 grammar lessons, diagnostics and spaced review of wrong answers
Reading to writing and listening to speaking practice with on-device recordings
Guest mode plus Google sign-in with cross-device progress sync

split.me: Learning goals, curriculum structure, architecture, agent rules, review
split.ai: Feature implementation through Codex and Claude Code pull requests
split.evidence: 18 merged pull requests with CI on every change

stations.title: WebGL / Three.js Lab
stations.summary: A 17-lesson path from a raw WebGL 2 triangle to a production Three.js scene. This page uses what it taught.
highlights: Lessons 01 to 03 in raw WebGL 2 and GLSL, 04 to 17 in Three.js
Theory PWA with runnable demos and synced progress
This portfolio reuses lessons 06, 08, 16 and 17: camera control, GPU lifecycle, frame-time budget, quality tiers

split.me: Learning roadmap, doing each lesson, deciding what goes into the app
split.ai: Drafting lesson text and porting demos through Codex and Claude Code
split.evidence: 17 lesson branches, each with its own CI build

stations.title: Department Work Manager
stations.role: Solo: gathering real requirements, direction, review
stations.summary: Assign, report and review work across a department hierarchy. Same problem as Tasken in 2017, solved again with today's tools.
highlights: Role-based access enforced in Postgres with row-level security
Reports, reviews and approval as separate, auditable steps
Permission tests run against real Postgres in WebAssembly (PGlite), no Docker needed

split.me: Collecting the real department documents and rules, steering, reviewing
split.ai: Codex planned and implemented the app from those documents
split.evidence: 17 merged pull requests, RLS test suite in CI
